scope.interactionChannel: real macOS secondary click and pointer selection after exact-PID AX frontmost activation

observations.name: physical system-menu reveal
observations.detail: A real secondary click on the visible main branch control opens a macOS system menu containing the single Copy branch name action. Accessibility reports an AXMenu and AXMenuItem owned by the exact Lynxtron PID.

observations.name: physical Copy branch name selection
observations.detail: After priming the system clipboard with t3-fidelity-sentinel, a real pointer selection at the exact AXMenuItem center closes the menu but leaves the sentinel unchanged instead of writing main. Return selection also leaves the sentinel unchanged.

classification.productLoss: The system-native branch menu is implemented and physically reachable, but Lynxtron 0.0.16 does not deliver the leaf selection result back to the renderer capability call.
missingCoverage: Dark-theme menu appearance was not repeated.
classification.harnessLoss: Application-name activation is ambiguous when multiple Lynxtron processes coexist; the retained run uses exact-PID AXFrontmost, AXFocusedWindow, and AXRaise. Mis-targeted frames were excluded.
classification.intentionalPlatformDelta: Native uses an operating-system menu rather than a renderer-drawn overlay.
